data.positioning_statement: For solo and technical founders whose businesses stop when they stop, Cambium is a viability-governed venture operator that keeps bounded AI agents coherent across time because it protects explicit limits, evolves only on evidence, gates consequence, and records every decision.

salience.problem_solved: The absence of continuity, mission regulation, and accountable consequence between finite agent runs.
salience.one_sentence: Cambium is the living operator above your AI agents, keeping the venture able to continue.

points_of_difference: Optimizes viability and mission rather than task volume or revenue as a terminal objective.
Keeps paid and irreversible actions behind explicit fail-closed founder gates.
Persists typed world-state and replayable decisions across otherwise finite agent runs.
points_of_parity: Coordinates specialist agents and existing business tools.
Automates routine bounded work after configuration.
Provides a view of current work, goals, and system state.

brand_associations: paths bending inward at a safe boundary
one patient steward across many gardens
usage_locations: the founder's quiet morning operating review
the portfolio operator's multi-venture command surface
the moment before a consequential agent action
usage_methods: approve or reject a bounded next game
replay why a previous move happened

positive_judgments: This is more honest than an autonomous-company promise.
The system knows where its authority stops.
I can understand why it wants to act.
Its patience is a feature, not a lack of ambition.
concerns_doubts: Will it become another complicated dashboard?
Can an abstract viability model be useful in a real small business?
Does human approval erase the value of automation?
Is this product implemented or only doctrine?
judgments.credibility: Credibility comes from explicit contracts, bounded claims, live receipts, and visible uncertainty; never from anthropomorphic confidence.

concern_responses.response: Lead with the one next bounded decision and reveal deeper proof only on demand.
Use a small set of named hard bounds and observable proxy margins; do not claim exact computation of a 1024-dimensional kernel.
Only consequence is gated. Reversible, pre-authorized finite work remains automatic.
Label every surface Doctrine, Local, Production, Held, or Retired and show the receipt supporting the label.

feelings.voice: patient, rigorous, alive, honest, and grounded
feelings.tone: warmly authoritative without hype, urgency theater, or synthetic certainty

resonance.why_missed: Founders do not need to watch another swarm perform busyness; they need evidence that the venture can continue without losing itself.
resonance.mission_alignment: Keeping small ventures in the game advances a world where more founders can pursue a cause without trading their health for continuity.
resonance.why_choose_us: Choose Cambium when the cost of silent drift is higher than the value of unbounded automation.

data.positioning_summary: Cambium occupies the space between AI-workforce tools and passive planning software. It is not a synthetic executive team, an agent builder, or an OKR dashboard. It is the meta-operator that decides when a finite specialist should play, checks whether that move preserves the venture's ability to continue, and keeps consequence legible to the human steward. Its category claim is intentionally narrow: viability-governed venture operations for founders who want continuity without theatrical autonomy.
